deleteAccount.title: Delete your SoftTime account
deleteAccount.intro: This page explains how to delete your account in the SoftTime app and what happens to your data.
deleteAccount.stepsTitle: How to delete your account in the app
steps: Open the SoftTime app and sign in.
Enter your password and confirm the deletion.
erased: Your name, email address and password.
Your profile photo link and any administrator note about you.
Push notification tokens of your devices.
deleteAccount.keptTitle: What is kept in anonymized form
deleteAccount.keptIntro: These records are needed by your company for working-time accounting and reports. They remain, but are no longer linked to your name or email — they are shown as "Deleted user" instead.
deleteAccount.after: A deleted account cannot be signed in to or restored. Your email address is released and you can register again.
deleteAccount.admin: The only administrator of a company cannot delete their account from the app, so the company is not left without a manager. In that case, write to us at the address below.
deleteAccount.contactTitle: Can't sign in, or need help?
deleteAccount.contact: Write to us from the email address you registered with and we will delete the account manually:
